utility.name: Holder and partner claims
utility.summary: The holder dashboard currently exposes 11 active claim paths across BuiltByEcho, Bankr, Darksol, and MiroShark.

utility.name: Gauntlet payment
utility.summary: Echo Gauntlet accepts ECHO on Base for a browser-persona website teardown. The current amount is returned by the public quote endpoint.

utility.name: Holder Request Pass
utility.summary: A wallet holding at least 1 ECHO can submit a request for a perk, tool, review, or partner reward through the holder dashboard.

utility.name: Partner and dual-holder credits
utility.summary: Eligible partner-token holders can claim starter tool credits, with additional claim paths for wallets that also hold ECHO.

utility.name: Contract verification
utility.summary: The ECHO token contract can be verified directly on BaseScan before any wallet action.
